name: Flight to Auberdine
summary: You carry unusual fish specimens from Teldrassil to Auberdine for Laird. Vesprystus sends you from Rut'theran Village by hippogryph.

sections.title: Taking Wing to Darkshore
sections.body: From Rut'theran Village, you fly by hippogryph toward Darkshore with fish specimens for Nessa Shadowsong. The village is a sanctuary at the edge of the wider world for young adventurers leaving Teldrassil. A ferry also crosses the strait between the island and mainland Kalimdor, while night elves travel by bonded hippogryph.

sections.title: Curious Catches
sections.body: At Auberdine's docks, Laird examines Nessa's findings. The scales are as large as fists, and the jawbone is nearly twice the size of mainland specimens. Waters around the base of the World Tree seem to yield altered or abnormally large life. The strange catches may be tied to Teldrassil's potent, restless nature.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this flight?
aliases: why do i fly to auberdine
faq.answer: You carry unusual fish specimens caught around Rut'theran Village to Laird in Auberdine on a hippogryph flight between the settlements.

faq.q: Who sends the parcel, and what is inside it?
faq.answer: Nessa Shadowsong, a fisherwoman, sends the parcel. It contains fish specimens from Rut'theran Village's waters, including massive scales and an oversized jawbone.

faq.q: Why are the fish from Teldrassil so large?
faq.answer: Laird finds scales as big as a fist and a jawbone nearly twice normal size. Waters around Teldrassil's World Tree seem to foster magnified wildlife compared with mainland Darkshore.
Vesprystus is the hippogryph master at Rut'theran Village. He tends the night elven mounts and arranges flights across the water to mainland Kalimdor.
Laird is a night elf fisherman in Auberdine on the coast of Darkshore. He studies local aquatic life and compares mainland catches with those near Teldrassil.

faq.q: Can you travel between Rut'theran and Auberdine without flying?
faq.answer: Yes. A regular ferry runs between the docks at Rut'theran Village and the pier at Auberdine, offering an alternative to the hippogryph flight.

angles.text: As a night elf, you fly by hippogryph to Auberdine, a rite of passage for young kaldorei leaving Teldrassil for the ancestral mainland.
As an Alliance traveler, you can take hippogryphs between coastal outposts across northern Kalimdor and the capital.
